path, enables WAL mode,\n303\t// and applies any pending migrations.\n304\tfunc OpenDB(path string) (*DB, error) {\n305\t\tdb, err := sql.Open(\"sqlite\", path)\n306\t\tif err != nil {\n307\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite %q: %w\", path, err)\n308\t\t}\n309\t\n310\t\t// SQLite works best with a single writer connection.\n311\t\tdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)\n312\t\n313\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n314\t\t\tdb.Close()\n315\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n316\t\t}\n317\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n318\t\t\tdb.Close()\n319\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n320\t\t}\n321\t\n322\t\td := &DB{db: db}\n323\t\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n324\t\t\tdb.Close()\n325\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n326\t\t}\n327\t\treturn d, nil\n328\t}\n329\t\n330\t// Close closes the underlying database connection.\n331\tfunc d.db\n338\t}\n339\t\n340\t// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n341\t// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\n342\tfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n343\t\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n344\t\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n345\t\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n346\t\t);`)\n347\t\tif err != nil {\n348\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n349\t\t}\n350\t\n351\t\tvar current int\n352\t\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n353\t\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n354\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n355\t\t}\n356\t\n357\t\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n358\t\t\tversion := i + 1\n359\t\t\tif version <= current {\n360\t\t\t\tcontinue\n361\t\t\t}\n362\t\n363\t\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n364\t\t\tif err != nil {\n365\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n366\t\t\t}\n367\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n368\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n369\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n370\t\t\t}\n371\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n372\t\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n373\t\t\t); err != nil {\n374\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n375\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n376\t\t\t}\n377\t\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n378\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n379\t\t\t}\n380\t\t}\n381\t\treturn nil\n382\t}\n383\t\n384\t// ── groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n385\t\n386\t// GetGroup returns the group with the AND thread_id = ?`, chatID, threadID)\n\treturn scanSession(row)\n}\n\n// CreateSession inserts a new session record.\nfunc (d *DB) CreateSession(ctx context.Context, s *Session) error {\n\tnow := time.Now().UTC()\n\tif s.CreatedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\ts.CreatedAt = now\n\t}\n\tif s.LastActive.IsZero() {\n\t\ts.LastActive = now\n\t}\n\tif s.Status == \"\" {\n\t\ts.Status = \"active\"\n\t}\n\tif s.IconColor == 0 {\n\t\ts.IconColor = 7322096 // Default to light blue (0x6FB9F0)\n\t}\n\tif s.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\ts.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO sessions\n\t\t   (chat_id, thread_id, session_id, cwd, model, status, icon_color, created_at, last_active, message_count, pinned_message_id, total_cost_usd, summary, notification_mode, timeout_sec)\n\t\t VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n\t\ts.ChatID, s.ThreadID, s.SessionID, s.CWD, nullableString(s.Model), s.Status,\n\t\ts.IconColor,\n\t\ts.CreatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.LastActive.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.MessageCount,\n\t\ts.PinnedMessageID,\n\t\ts.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnullableString(s.Summary),\n\t\ts.NotificationMode,\n\t\ts.TimeoutSec,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// UpdateSession updates mutable fields on an existing session.\nfunc (d *DB) UpdateSession(ctx context.Context, s *Session) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`UPDATE sessions\n\t\t SET session_id    = ?,\n\t\t     cwd           = ?,\n\t\t     model         = ?,\n\t\t     status        = ?,\n\t\t     icon_color    = ?,\n\t\t     last_active   = ?,\n\t\t     message_count = ?,\n\t\t     pinned_message_id = ?,\n\t\t     total_cost_usd    = ?,\n\t\t     summary           = ?,\n\t\t     notification_mode = ?,\n\t\t     timeout_sec       = ?,\n\t\t     dispatcher_mode   = ?\n\t\t WHERE chat_id = ? AND thread_id = ?`,\n\t\ts.SessionID, s.CWD, nullableString(s.Model), s.Status,\n\t\ts.IconColor,\n\t\ts.LastActive.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.MessageCount,\n\t\ts.PinnedMessageID,\n\t\ts.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnullableString(s.Summary),\n\t\ts.NotificationMode,\n\t\ts.TimeoutSec,\n\t\ts.DispatcherMode,\n\t\ts.ChatID, s.ThreadID,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// SetSessionIconColor updates only the icon_color field for a session.\nfunc (d *DB) SetSessionIconColor(ctx context.Context, chatID, threadID int64, color int) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`UPDATE sessions SET icon_color = ? WHERE chat_id = ? AND thread_id = ?`,\n\t\tnullableString(summary), chatID, threadID,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\ntype sessionScanner interface {\n\tScan(dest ...any) error\n}\n\nfunc scanSession(s sessionScanner) (*Session, error) {\n\tvar sess Session\n\tvar createdAt, lastActive string\n\terr := s.Scan(\n\t\t&sess.ChatID, &sess.ThreadID, &sess.SessionID, &sess.CWD,\n\t\t&sess.Model, &sess.Status, &createdAt, &lastActive, &sess.MessageCount, &sess.IconColor,\n\t\t&sess.PinnedMessageID, &sess.TotalCostUSD, &sess.Summary, &sess.NotificationMode, &sess.TimeoutSec,\n\t\t&sess.DispatcherMode,\n\t)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tsess.CreatedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, createdAt)\n\tsess.LastActive, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, lastActive)\n\tif sess.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\tsess.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\treturn &sess, nil\n}\n\n// ── allowed_users ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n// IsUserAllowed returns true if userID is in the allowed_users table.\nfunc (d *DB) IsUserAllowed(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (bool, error) {\n\tvar count int\n\terr := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID,\n\t).Scan(&count)\n\treturn count > 0, err\n}\n\n// GetUserRole returns the role for a user (\"admin\" or \"user\").\n// Returns empty string if user not found.\nfunc (d *DB) GetUserRole(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (string, error) {\n\tvar role string\n\terr := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT role FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID,\n\t).Scan(&role)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn \"\", nil\n\t}\n\treturn role, err\n}\n\n// IsUserAdmin returns true if the user has an \"admin\" role.\nfunc (d *DB) IsUserAdmin(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (bool, error) {\n\trole, err := d.GetUserRole(ctx, userID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn false, err\n\t}\n\treturn role == \"admin\", nil\n}\n\n// GetAllowedUser returns the allowed user record, or (nil, nil) if not found.\nfunc (d *DB) GetAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (*AllowedUser, error) {\n\trow := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT user_id, role, added_at FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID)\n\n\tvar u AllowedUser\n\tvar addedAt string\n\terr := row.Scan(&u.UserID, &u.Role, &addedAt)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tu.AddedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, addedAt)\n\treturn &u, nil\n}\n\n// UpsertAllowedUser inserts or updates an allowed user.\nfunc (d *DB) UpsertAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, u *AllowedUser) error {\n\tif u.AddedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\tu.AddedAt = time.Now().UTC()\n\t}\n\tif u.Role == \"\" {\n\t\tu.Role = \"user\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO allowed_users (user_id, role, added_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n\t\t ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role`,\n\t\tu.UserID, u.Role, u.AddedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// DeleteAllowedUser removes a user from the allow list.\nfunc (d *DB) DeleteAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, userID int64) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`DELETE FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// ListAllowedUsers returns all allowed users ordered by added_at.\nfunc (d *DB) ListAllowedUsers(ctx context.Context) ([]*AllowedUser, error) {\n\trows, err := d.db.QueryContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT user_id, role, added_at FROM allowed_users ORDER BY added_at`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer rows.Close()\n\n\tvar users []*AllowedUser\n\tfor rows.Next() {\n\t\tvar u AllowedUser\n\t\tvar addedAt string\n\t\tif err := rows.Scan(&u.UserID, &u.Role, &addedAt); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tu.AddedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, addedAt)\n\t\tusers = append(users, &u)\n\t}\n\treturn users, rows.Err()\n}\n\n// EnsureAdminUser ensures a user exists as an admin in the database.\n// If the user doesn't closed and\n// closes the corresponding Telegram topic via the proxy.\nfunc (h *CommandHandler) cmdClose(ctx context.Context, update contract.Update, group *Group, args string) (string, error) {\n\tif colorErr != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[bridge/commands] edit topic color failed for (%d, %d): %v\", update.ChatID, threadID, colorErr)\n\t}\n\n\t// Best-effort: also close the Telegram topic via proxy.\n\tif topicErr := h.closeTopic(ctx, update.ChatID, threadID); topicErr != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[bridge/commands] close_topic failed for (%d, %d): %v\", update.ChatID, threadID, topicErr)\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"Session closed and marked complete (thread %d). err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"decode proxy health: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Format uptime from seconds\n\tuptime := fmt.Sprintf(\"%ds\", proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds)\n\tif proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds >= 3600 {\n\t\thours := proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds / 3600\n\t\tmins := (proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds % 3600) / 60\n\t\tuptime = fmt.Sprintf(\"%dh%dm\", hours, mins)\n\t} else if proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds >= 60 {\n\t\tmins := proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds / 60\n\t\tsecs := proxyHealth.UptimeSeconds % 60\n\t\tuptime = fmt.Sprintf(\"%dm%ds\", mins, secs)\n\t}\n\n\t// Build version string\n\tvar sb strings.Builder\n\t// Version string may already have \"v\" prefix from git describe\n\tver := h.bridgeVer\n\tif !strings.HasPrefix(ver, \"v\") {\n\t\tver = \"v\" + ver\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(&sb, \"Bridge: %s (%s) built %s\\n\", ver, h.bridgeSHA, h.buildDate)\n\tif proxyHealth.Version != \"\" {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&sb, \"Proxy:  v%s (%s) uptime %s\\n\", proxyHealth.Version, proxyHealth.CommitSHA, uptime)\n\t} else {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&sb, \"Proxy:  (unknown version) uptime %s\\n\", uptime)\n\t}\n\tfmt.Fprintf(&sb, \"Contract: %s\", contract.ContractVersion)\n\n\treturn strings.TrimRight(sb.String(), \"\\n\"), nil\n}\n\n// cmdUpdate handles /update [do] — checks for or applies updates (admin only).\nfunc (h *CommandHandler) cmdUpdate(ctx context.Context, update contract.Update, args string) (string, error) {\n\tif h.updater == nil {\n\t\treturn \"Update functionality not enabled.\", nil\n\t}\n\n\t// Check for update requires admin access\n\tuserID := update.FromUser.ID\n\tisAdmin, err := h.db.IsUserAdmin(ctx, userID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"check admin status: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !isAdmin {\n\t\treturn \"Permission denied. Note: could not update Telegram topic: %v\", colorName, err), nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"Topic color set to: %s\", colorName), nil\n}\n\n// colorToName converts an icon color integer to a human-readable name.\nfunc colorToName(color int) string {\n\tswitch color {\n\tcase ColorActive:\n\t\treturn \"active\"\n\tcase ColorComplete:\n\t\treturn \"complete\"\n\tcase ColorBlocked:\n\t\treturn \"blocked\"\n\tcase ColorError:\n\t\treturn \"error\"\n\tcase ColorReview:\n\t\treturn \"review\"\n\tcase ColorResearch:\n\t\treturn \"research\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"unknown (%d)\", color)\n\t}\n}\n\n// cmdNotify handles /notify [mode] — sets the notification mode for this topic.\n// Valid modes: live (stream every update), summary (final response only), quiet (only notify on completion/error).\nfunc (h *CommandHandler) cmdNotify(ctx context.Context, update contract.Update, group *Group, args string) (string, error) {\n\tif update.ThreadID == nil {\n\t\treturn \"Notification mode commands only work within a topic session. *update.ThreadID}\n\n\tm.mu.Lock()\n\tworker, ok := m.topics[key]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tworkerCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())\n\t\tworker = &topicWorker{\n\t\t\tch:     make(chan sessionMsg, topicQueueCapacity),\n\t\t\tcancel: cancel,\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.topics[key] = worker\n\t\tgo m.runWorker(workerCtx, key, worker)\n\t}\n\tm.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tmsg := sessionMsg{update: update, It dispatches Claude invocations to\n// background goroutines so it is never blocked waiting for Claude to finish.\n// Messages that arrive while an invocation is running are buffered in-memory\n// and processed as a batch once the goroutine completes, preserving ordering\n// while keeping the worker available for future messages.\nfunc (m *SessionManager) runWorker(ctx context.Context, key topicKey, worker *topicWorker) {\n\tdefer func() {\n\t\tm.mu.Lock()\n\t\tdelete(m.topics, key)\n\t\tm.mu.Unlock()\n\t}()\n\n\tvar (\n\t\tactiveDone <-chan struct{} // closed when the active invocation goroutine exits\n\t\tpending    []sessionMsg    // messages buffered while an invocation is running\n\t)\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tselect {\n\t\tcase msg := <-worker.ch:\n\t\t\tif activeDone != nil {\n\t\t\t\t// Invocation in progress — buffer for later to preserve ordering.\n\t\t\t\tpending = append(pending, msg)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t// Idle — drain the inbox and start an invocation goroutine.\n\t\t\t\tactiveDone = m.startInvocation(ctx, key, drainWith(worker.ch, msg))\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\tcase <-activeDone:\n\t\t\tactiveDone = nil\n\t\t\t// Absorb any messages that landed in the inbox during the final tick.\n\t\tabsorb:\n\t\t\tfor {\n\t\t\t\tselect {\n\t\t\t\tcase msg := <-worker.ch:\n\t\t\t\t\tpending = append(pending, msg)\n\t\t\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\t\t\tbreak absorb\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif len(pending) > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tbatch := pending\n\t\t\t\tpending = nil\n\t\t\t\tactiveDone = m.startInvocation(ctx, key, batch)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// startInvocation spawns a goroutine that calls processBatch and returns a\n// channel that is closed when the goroutine exits.\nfunc (m *SessionManager) []sessionMsg{first}\n\tfor {\n\t\tselect {\n\t\tcase msg := <-ch:\n\t\t\tbatch = append(batch, msg)\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\treturn batch\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// processBatch resolves the current recordings).\n\tvar stopTyping func()\n\tfor _, msg := range batch {\n\t\tif msg.update.Content != nil &&\n\t\t\t(msg.update.Content.Type == contract.ContentTypeVoice ||\n\t\t\t\tmsg.update.Content.Type == contract.ContentTypeAudio ||\n\t\t\t\tmsg.update.Content.Type == contract.ContentTypeVideo ||\n\t\t\t\tmsg.update.Content.Type == contract.ContentTypeVideoNote) make([]msgExtra, len(batch))\n\tfor i, msg := range batch {\n\t\tif msg.update.Content == nil || msg.update.Content.FileID == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch msg.update.Content.Type {\n\t\tcase contract.ContentTypePhoto:\n\t\t\tpath, err := m.processPhoto(ctx, key.chatID, msg.update.MessageID, *msg.update.Content.FileID)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] {\n\t\t\t\t\ttextBuf.WriteString(delta.Delta.Text)\n\t\t\t\t\tflushEdit(false)\n\t\t\t\t\t// Text delta after a tool_use block means the tool succeeded\n\t\t\t\t\tif activeTool != \"\" && toolCompleted {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tactiveTool = \"\"\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoolInput = \"\"\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Try to parse as content_block_start (for tool_use start)\n\t\t\tvar start contentBlockStart\n\t\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(env.Event, &start); err == nil {\n\t\t\t\tif start.Type == \"content_block_start\" && start.ContentBlock.Type == \"tool_use\" {\n\t\t\t\t\t// Check for spawn_worker synthetic tool\n\t\t\t\t\tif start.ContentBlock.Name == \"spawn_worker\" {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tsyntheticToolID := fmt.Sprintf(\"toolu_%d\", time.Now().UnixNano())\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Spawn the worker — it runs in a goroutine and returns immediately\n\t\t\t\t\t\tworkerID, workerIndex, spawnErr := m.workerPool.SpawnWorker(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsubprocCtx, chatID, *threadID, origMsgID, group, start.ContentBlock.Input.Raw,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\tvar toolContent any\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif spawnErr != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\ttoolContent = map[string]any{\"error\": spawnErr.Error()}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] spawn_worker failed: %v\", spawnErr)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\ttoolContent = map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"worker_id\": workerID,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"index\":     workerIndex,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"status\":    \"dispatched\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] spawned worker %d (%s) for (%d,%d)\", workerIndex, workerID, chatID, *threadID)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Write tool_result back to stdin so the orchestrator can continue\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoolResult := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"tool_use_id\": syntheticToolID,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"content\":     toolContent,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"is_error\":    spawnErr != nil,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\tresultJSON, _ := json.Marshal(toolResult)\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif _, err := fmt.Fprintf(stdinW, \"%s\\n\", resultJSON); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] write tool_result for spawn_worker: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t// Check for update_progress synthetic tool\n\t\t\t\t\tif start.ContentBlock.Name == \"update_progress\" {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tsyntheticToolID := fmt.Sprintf(\"toolu_%d\", time.Now().UnixNano())\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Parse the input to get the message\n\t\t\t\t\t\tvar input updateProgressInput\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(start.ContentBlock.Input.Raw, &input); err == nil && input.Message != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// Only send update_progress messages in live mode\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tif notificationMode == \"live\" {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// Send a new message to the Telegram thread (not an edit)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tif err := m.sender.SendResponse(sendCtx, chatID, threadID, 0, input.Message); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] send update_progress message: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// Reset the progress ticker timer\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlastSent = time.Now()\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Write tool_result back to stdin so the orchestrator can continue\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoolResult := map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"tool_use_id\": syntheticToolID,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"content\":     map[string]any{\"ok\": true},\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"is_error\":    false,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\tresultJSON, _ := json.Marshal(toolResult)\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif _, err := fmt.Fprintf(stdinW, \"%s\\n\", resultJSON); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] write tool_result for update_progress: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t// Regular tool handling - send status update\n\t\t\t\t\tactiveTool = start.ContentBlock.Name\n\t\t\t\t\ttoolInput = start.ContentBlock.Input.String()\n\t\t\t\t\ttoolCompleted = false\n\t\t\t\t\tstatus := fmt.Sprintf(\"⚙️ Running %s: `%s`\", activeTool, toolInput)\n\t\t\t\t\tflushToolEdit(true, status) // force immediate update\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Try to parse as content_block_stop (for tool_use completion)\n\t\t\tvar stop contentBlockStop\n\t\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(env.Event, &stop); err == nil {\n\t\t\t\tif stop.Type == \"content_block_stop\" {\n\t\t\t\t\t// Tool is completing - send status update\n\t\t\t\t\tif activeTool != \"\" && !toolCompleted {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tstatus := fmt.Sprintf(\"✓ %s done\", activeTool)\n\t\t\t\t\t\tflushToolEdit(false, status) // debounce\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoolCompleted = true\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Try to parse as tool_result_delta (actual tool result streaming)\n\t\t\tvar trDelta toolResultDelta\n\t\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(env.Event, &trDelta); err == nil {\n\t\t\t\tif trDelta.Type == \"tool_result_delta\" {\n\t\t\t\t\t// Tool result is streaming - tool has executed\n\t\t\t\t\tif activeTool != \"\" && !toolCompleted {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tstatus := fmt.Sprintf(\"✓ %s done\", activeTool)\n\t\t\t\t\t\tflushToolEdit(false, status) // debounce\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoolCompleted = true\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"result\":\n\t\t\t// Canonical final event — overwrite session_id with the authoritative value.\n\t\t\tout.Type = env.Type\n\t\t\tout.SessionID = env.SessionID\n\t\t\tout.Result = env.Result\n\t\t\tout.IsError = env.IsError\n\t\t\tout.TotalCostUSD = env.TotalCostUSD\n\t\t\tout.Usage = env.Usage\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Final flush to ensure all accumulated text is sent\n\tflushEdit(true)\n\n\tif err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {\n\t\t_ = cmd.Process.Kill()\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read stdout: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := cmd.Wait(); err != nil {\n\t\tif exitErr, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError); ok {\n\t\t\tstderrStr := strings.TrimSpace(stderrBuf.String())\n\t\t\tif stderrStr != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"claude exited %d: %s\", exitErr.ExitCode(), stderrStr)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"claude exited %d\", exitErr.ExitCode())\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"wait claude: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tif out.IsError {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"claude error: %s\", out.Result)\n\t}\n\n\t// Detect generated media files in the working directory\n\t// Look for audio/video files created during this invocation\n\tif err := m.detectGeneratedMedia(group.CWD, startTime, &out); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] detect generated media: %v\", err)\n\t\t// Non-fatal: continue without media attachments\n\t}\n\n\t// Handle notification modes for final output\n\tif notificationMode == \"summary\" {\n\t\t// Summary mode: replace placeholder with full result\n\t\t// streamMsgID will be 0 since we didn't stream, so use placeholderID\n\t\tif streamMsgID == 0 && placeholderID != 0 {\n\t\t\tout.StreamMsgID = placeholderID\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tout.StreamMsgID = streamMsgID\n\t\t}\n\t} else if notificationMode == \"quiet\" {\n\t\t// Quiet mode: replace result with minimal confirmation\n\t\tout.Result = \"Done ✓\"\n\t\tout.StreamMsgID = 0 // No streaming happened\n\t} else {\n\t\t// Live mode: normal streaming behavior\n\t\tout.StreamMsgID = streamMsgID\n\t}\n\tout.PlaceholderID = placeholderID\n\treturn &out, nil\n}\n\n// persistSession writes a new session record or updates the existing one.\n// fromUserID is the Telegram user ID of the user who triggered this invocation.\nfunc (m *SessionManager) persistSession(ctx context.Context, key topicKey, existing *Session, group *Group, out *claudeOutput, fromUserID int64) error {\n\tif existing == nil {\n\t\t// New session: create the record\n\t\tsess := &Session{\n\t\t\tChatID:       key.chatID,\n\t\t\tThreadID:     key.threadID,\n\t\t\tSessionID:    out.SessionID,\n\t\t\tCWD:          group.CWD,\n\t\t\tModel:        resolveSessionModel(nil, group),\n\t\t\tStatus:       \"active\",\n\t\t\tMessageCount: 1,\n\t\t\tTotalCostUSD: out.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := m.db.CreateSession(ctx, sess); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Publish session created event\n\t\tif m.eventPublisher != nil {\n\t\t\tm.eventPublisher.PublishSessionCreated(sessionToMap(sess))\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Record detailed cost event for the first invocation\n\t\tcostEvent := &CostEvent{\n\t\t\tChatID:     key.chatID,\n\t\t\tThreadID:   key.threadID,\n\t\t\tCostUSD:    out.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\t\tModel:      resolveSessionModel(nil, group),\n\t\t\tFromUserID: fromUserID,\n\t\t\tCreatedAt:  time.Now().UTC(),\n\t\t}\n\t\tif out.Usage != nil {\n\t\t\tcostEvent.InputTokens = out.Usage.InputTokens\n\t\t\tcostEvent.OutputTokens = out.Usage.OutputTokens\n\t\t\tcostEvent.CacheReadTokens = out.Usage.CacheReadTokens\n\t\t\tcostEvent.CacheCreationTokens = out.Usage.CacheCreationTokens\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := m.db.RecordCostEvent(ctx, costEvent); err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] record cost event (%d,%d): %v\", key.chatID, key.threadID, err)\n\t\t\t// Non-fatal: continue anyway\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Publish cost recorded event\n\t\tif m.eventPublisher != nil && out.TotalCostUSD > 0 {\n\t\t\tm.eventPublisher.PublishCostRecorded(key.chatID, key.threadID, out.TotalCostUSD, resolveSessionModel(nil, group))\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Send and pin the initial metadata message\n\t\tpinnedMsgID, err := m.createAndPinMetadata(ctx, sess, group)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] send and pin metadata: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t// Non-fatal: continue without pinned message\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Store the pinned message ID in the session\n\t\tsess.PinnedMessageID = pinnedMsgID\n\t\tif err := m.db.UpdateSession(ctx, sess); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Publish session updated event\n\t\tif m.eventPublisher != nil {\n\t\t\tm.eventPublisher.PublishSessionUpdated(sessionToMap(sess))\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\t// Existing session: update the record\n\texisting.SessionID = out.SessionID\n\texisting.LastActive = time.Now().UTC()\n\texisting.MessageCount++\n\texisting.TotalCostUSD += out.TotalCostUSD\n\tif err := m.db.UpdateSession(ctx, existing); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// Publish session updated event\n\tif m.eventPublisher != nil {\n\t\tm.eventPublisher.PublishSessionUpdated(sessionToMap(existing))\n\t}\n\n\t// Record detailed cost event\n\tcostEvent := &CostEvent{\n\t\tChatID:     key.chatID,\n\t\tThreadID:   key.threadID,\n\t\tCostUSD:    out.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tModel:      resolveSessionModel(existing, group),\n\t\tFromUserID: fromUserID,\n\t\tCreatedAt:  time.Now().UTC(),\n\t}\n\tif out.Usage != nil {\n\t\tcostEvent.InputTokens = out.Usage.InputTokens\n\t\tcostEvent.OutputTokens = out.Usage.OutputTokens\n\t\tcostEvent.CacheReadTokens = out.Usage.CacheReadTokens\n\t\tcostEvent.CacheCreationTokens = out.Usage.CacheCreationTokens\n\t}\n\tif err := m.db.RecordCostEvent(ctx, costEvent); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[session_mgr] record cost event (%d,%d): %v\", key.chatID, key.threadID, err)\n\t\t// Non-fatal: continue anyway\n\t}\n\n\t// Publish cost recorded event\n\tif m.eventPublisher != nil && out.TotalCostUSD > 0 {\n\t\tm.eventPublisher.PublishCostRecorded(key.chatID, key.threadID, out.TotalCostUSD, resolveSessionModel(existing, group))\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// createAndPinMetadata sends and pins a metadata message for a session.\nfunc (m *SessionManager) createAndPinMetadata(ctx context.Context, session *Session, group *Group) (int64, error) {\n\tmetadata := m.formatMetadata(session, group)\n\treturn m.sender.SendAndPinMetadata(ctx, session.ChatID, session.ThreadID, metadata)\n}\n\n// formatMetadata builds the metadata text for a session.\nfunc (m *SessionManager) formatMetadata(session *Session, group *Group) string {\n\tmodel := session.Model\n\tif model == \"\" && group != nil {\n\t\tmodel = group.DefaultModel\n\t}\n\tif model == \"\" {\n\t\tmodel = defaultSessionModel\n\t}\n\n\tnotifyMode := session.NotificationMode\n\tif notifyMode == \"\" {\n\t\tnotifyMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"Session: %s\\nProject: %s\\nModel: %s\\nStarted: %s UTC\\nMessages: %d\\nCost: $%.2f\\nNotify: %s\",\n\t\tsession.SessionID,\n\t\tsession.CWD,\n\t\tmodel,\n\t\tsession.CreatedAt.Format(\"2006-01-02 15:04\"),\n\t\tsession.MessageCount,\n\t\tsession.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnotifyMode)\n}\n\n// updatePinnedMetadata updates the pinned metadata message for a session.\n// Debounced to at most once per minute per session.\nfunc (m *SessionManager) updatePinnedMetadata(ctx context.Context, session *Session, group *Group) error {\n\tif session.PinnedMessageID == 0 {\n\t\t// No pinned message to update\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tkey := topicKey{chatID: session.ChatID, threadID: session.ThreadID}\n\n\t// Check debounce: skip if updated less than a minute ago\n\tm.mu.Lock()\n\tlastSeen, exists := m.pinnedUpdateLastSeen[key]\n\tif exists && time.Since(lastSeen) < time.Minute {\n\t\tm.mu.Unlock()\n\t\treturn nil // Skip this update\n\t}\n\t// Mark this update time\n\tm.pinnedUpdateLastSeen[key] = time.Now()\n\tm.mu.Unlock()\n\n\t// Build the metadata text\n\tmetadata := m.formatMetadata(session, group)\n\n\t// Edit the pinned message\n\treturn m.sender.EditMessage(ctx, session.ChatID, session.PinnedMessageID, metadata)\n}\n\n// buildSessionPrompt constructs the prompt from a batch of messages.\n// extras maps each batch index to resolved attachment data (image path or transcription).\n// Single message: used as-is.\n// Multiple messages: previous ones listed under a header, last one highlighted.\n// Pinned snippets are prepended first, then worker results, then pending context.\nfunc (m *SessionManager) buildSessionPrompt(ctx context.Context, key topicKey, batch []sessionMsg, extras []msgExtra) string {\n\ttexts := make([]string, 0, len(batch))\n\tfor i, msg := range batch {\n\t\tvar ex msgExtra\n\t\tif i < len(extras) {\n\t\t\tex = extras[i]\n\t\t}\n\t\tif t := sessionMsgText(msg.update, ex); t != \"\" {\n\t\t\ttexts = append(texts, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Build the base prompt\n\tvar basePrompt string\n\tswitch len(texts) {\n\tcase 0:\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\tcase 1:\n\t\tbasePrompt = texts[0]\n\tdefault:\n\t\tbasePrompt = fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\"Previous messages while processing:\\n\\n%s\\n\\nLatest message:\\n%s\",\n\t\t\tstrings.Join(texts[:len(texts)-1], \"\\n\\n\"),\n\t\t\ttexts[len(texts)-1],\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\t// Check for pending worker results and prepend them\n\tm.mu.Lock()\n\tworkerResults, hasWorkerResults := m.pendingWorkerResults[key]\n\tif hasWorkerResults {\n\t\tdelete(m.pendingWorkerResults, key) // Clear after use\n\t}\n\tm.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tprompt := basePrompt\n\tif hasWorkerResults && len(workerResults) > 0 {\n\t\tvar resultParts []string\n\t\tfor _, wr := range workerResults {\n\t\t\tif wr.Result == \"\" && wr.Error != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tresultParts = append(resultParts, fmt.Sprintf(\"Worker %d (model: %s) FAILED: %s\", wr.Index, wr.Model, wr.Error))\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tresultParts = append(resultParts, fmt.Sprintf(\"Worker %d (model: %s): %s\", wr.Index, wr.Model, wr.Result))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tworkerResultsText := fmt.Sprintf(\"[Worker results from previous invocation]\\n%s\", strings.Join(resultParts, \"\\n\"))\n\t\tprompt = fmt.Sprintf(\"%s\\n\\n[User message]\\n%s\", workerResultsText, prompt)\n\t}\n\n\t// Prepend pinned snippets (injected into all prompts for this chat)\n\tpinnedSnippets := m.GetPinnedSnippetsContext(ctx, key.chatID)\n\tif pinnedSnippets != \"\" {\n\t\tprompt = fmt.Sprintf(\"%s\\n\\n---\\n\\n%s\", pinnedSnippets, prompt)\n\t}\n\n\t// Check for pending context and prepend it (after worker results and pinned snippets)\n\tm.mu.Lock()\n\tpendingCtx, hasPending := m.pendingContext[key]\n\tif hasPending {\n\t\tdelete(m.pendingContext, key) // Clear after use\n\t}\n\tm.mu.Unlock()\n\n\tif hasPending && pendingCtx != \"\" {\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"Context from another topic:\\n\\n%s\\n\\n---\\n\\n%s\", pendingCtx, prompt)\n\t}\n\n\treturn prompt\n}\n\n// sessionMsgText extracts the prompt text from an update.\n// ex carries attachment data resolved before calling this function (image path,\n// transcription text, etc.). Returns \"\" for unsupported types or failed downloads.\nfunc sessionMsgText(update contract.Update, ex msgExtra) string {\n\tif update.Content == nil {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\tswitch update.Content.Type {\n\tcase contract.ContentTypeText:\n\t\tif update.Content.Text == nil {\n\t\t\treturn \"\"\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn *update.Content.Text\n\tcase contract.ContentTypePhoto:\n\t\tif ex.imagePath == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn \"\" // download failed; skip silently\n\t\t}\n\t\tif update.Content.Caption != nil && *update.Content.Caption != \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"[Image: %s]\\nCaption: %s\\nPlease analyze this image.\",\n\t\t\t\tex.imagePath, *update.Content.Caption)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"[User sent an image: %s]\\nPlease analyze this image.\", ex.imagePath)\n\tcase contract.ContentTypeVoice:\n\t\tif ex.transcription == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn \"\" // transcription failed; skip silently\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"[Voice message transcription]: %s\\n\\nPlease respond to the above.\", ex.transcription)\n\tcase contract.ContentTypeAudio:\n\t\tif ex.transcription == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn \"\" // transcription failed; skip silently\n\t\t}\n\t\tif ex.audioTitle != \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"[Audio file %q transcription]: %s\\n\\nPlease respond to the above.\",\n\t\t\t\tex.audioTitle, ex.transcription)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"[Audio transcription]: %s\\n\\nPlease respond to the above.\", ex.transcription)\n\tcase contract.ContentTypeVideo, contract.ContentTypeVideoNote:\n\t\tvar parts []string\n\t\tvideoType := \"video\"\n\t\tif update.Content.Type == contract.ContentTypeVideoNote {\n\t\t\tvideoType = \"video note\"\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add keyframes if any were extracted.\n\t\tif len(ex.keyframePaths) > 0 {\n\t\t\tparts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf(\"[User sent a %s with %d keyframe(s)]\", videoType, len(ex.keyframePaths)))\n\t\t\tfor i, path := range ex.keyframePaths {\n\t\t\t\tparts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf(\"  Keyframe %d: %s\", i+1, path))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tparts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf(\"[User sent a %s]\", videoType))\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add caption if present.\n\t\tif ex.videoCaption != \"\" {\n\t\t\tparts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf(\"Caption: %s\", ex.videoCaption))\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add transcription if available.\n\t\tif ex.transcription != \"\" {\n\t\t\tparts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf(\"Audio transcription: %s\", ex.transcription))\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif len(parts) > 0 {\n\t\t\tparts = append(parts, \"Please analyze this video content.\")\n\t\t\treturn strings.Join(parts, \"\\n\")\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn \"\" // processing failed; skip silently\n\tcase contract.ContentTypeDocument:\n\t\tif ex.docPath == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn \"\" // download failed; skip silently\n\t\t}\n\t\tvar fileName string\n\t\tif update.Content.FileName != nil {\n\t\t\tfileName = *update.Content.FileName\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tfileName = \"uploaded file\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tif ex.docMsg != \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"[Document: %s]\\nPath: %s\\n\\n%s\\n\\nPlease analyze this document.\",\n\t\t\t\tfileName, ex.docPath, ex.docMsg)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"[Document: %s]\\nPath: %s\\n\\nPlease analyze this document.\",\n\t\t\tfileName, ex.docPath)\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\n// resolveSessionModel returns the model to use for a Claude invocation.\n// Priority: session.Model > group.DefaultModel > built-in default.\nfunc resolveSessionModel(session *Session, group *Group) string {\n\tif session != nil && session.Model != \"\" {\n\t\treturn session.Model\n\t}\n\tif group != nil && group.DefaultModel != \"\" {\n\t\treturn group.DefaultModel\n\t}\n\treturn defaultSessionModel\n}\n\n// dispatcherSystemPrompt is the system prompt injected into orchestrator sessions\n// when dispatcher mode is enabled. It describes the spawn_worker and update_progress\n// synthetic tools so Claude knows to use them.\nconst dispatcherSystemPrompt = `You are running as an orchestrator in a Telegram Claude Bridge.\nYou have access to two bridge-provided tools:\n\nspawn_worker(prompt, model?)\n  Dispatches a new headless Claude instance to execute prompt independently.\n  Returns {worker_id}. The worker result will be delivered to you as a tool_result\n  and also posted directly to the Telegram thread.\n\nupdate_progress(message)\n  Posts a status message to the Telegram thread numbers are treated as seconds.\n// Returns the duration in seconds, or -1 if no valid duration found.\nfunc parseDuration(text string) int {\n\tlower := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(text))\n\n\t// Match: number + unit (minutes/minute/hours/hour/seconds/second)\n\t// Look for the first occurrence of a number followed by a time unit\n\twords := strings.Fields(lower)\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(words)-1; i++ {\n\t\t// Try to parse the current word as a number\n\t\tvar amount int\n\t\tif _, err := fmt.Sscanf(words[i], \"%d\", &amount); err != nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Check the next word for a time unit\n\t\tunit := words[i+1]\n\t\tswitch {\n\t\tcase strings.HasPrefix(unit, \"minute\"):\n\t\t\treturn amount * 60\n\t\tcase strings.HasPrefix(unit, \"hour\"):\n\t\t\treturn amount * 3600\n\t\tcase strings.HasPrefix(unit, \"second\"):\n\t\t\treturn amount\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Bare number: treat as seconds\n\tif len(words) == 1 {\n\t\tvar amount int\n\t\tif _, err := fmt.Sscanf(words[0], \"%d\", &amount); err == nil && amount > 0 {\n\t\t\treturn amount\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn -1\n}\n\n// removeDuration removes a duration phrase from text.\n// Returns the text with the duration removed and whitespace cleaned up.\nfunc removeDuration(text string) string {\n\tlower := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(text))\n\n\t// Match: number + unit (minutes/minute/hours/hour/seconds/second)\n\twords := strings.Fields(lower)\n\tif len(words) < 2 {\n\t\treturn text\n\t}\n\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(words)-1; i++ {\n\t\t// Try to parse the current word as a number\n\t\tvar amount int\n\t\tif _, err := fmt.Sscanf(words[i], \"%d\", &amount); err != nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Check the next word for a time unit\n\t\tunit := words[i+1]\n\t\tif strings.HasPrefix(unit, \"minute\") || strings.HasPrefix(unit, \"hour\") || strings.HasPrefix(unit, \"second\") {\n\t\t\t// Found a duration - remove it from the original text\n\t\t\t// Find the position of this duration in the original text\n\t\t\toriginalWords := strings.Fields(text)\n\t\t\tif i < len(originalWords)-1 {\n\t\t\t\t// Reconstruct text without the duration words\n\t\t\t\tvar result []string\n\t\t\t\tresult = append(result, originalWords[:i]...)\n\t\t\t\tif i+2 < len(originalWords) {\n\t\t\t\t\tresult = append(result, originalWords[i+2:]...)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\treturn strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(result, \" \"))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn text\n}\n\n// newSessionIntent holds the result of new session intent precedence:\n// 1. Text after \"called\", \"for\", \"named\", or \":\" up to 50 chars or end of message\n// 2. First 4 words of the text\n// 3. \"Session <timestamp>\" if text is empty\nfunc extractTopicName(text string) string {\n\ttext = strings.TrimSpace(text)\n\tif text == \"\" {\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"Session %d\", time.Now().Unix())\n\t}\n\n\tlower := strings.ToLower(text)\n\n\t// Check for name indicators: \"called\", \"for\", \"named\", \":\"\n\tindicators := []string{\" called \", \" for \", \" named \", \":\"}\n\tfor _, indicator := range indicators {\n\t\tidx := strings.Index(lower, indicator)\n\t\tif idx != -1 {\n\t\t\t// Extract the name after the indicator\n\t\t\tnameStart := idx + len(indicator)\n\t\t\tname := strings.TrimSpace(text[nameStart:])\n\n\t\t\t// Truncate at 50 chars or at sentence boundaries\n\t\t\tif len(name) > 50 {\n\t\t\t\t// Try to truncate at a word boundary\n\t\t\t\tcut := 50\n\t\t\t\tfor ;
